nodes.summary: There is no finite non-soluble group $G$ such that, choosing a representative $H$ of each conjugacy class of subgroups of $G$, the rational-valued permutation characters $1_H^G$ of $G$ on the left cosets of these subgroups $H$ are linearly independent over $\mathbb{Q}$.
nodes.title: No insoluble group has independent permutation characters (Kourovka 11.9)

nodes.summary: A function $\varphi : G \to \mathbb{C}$ on a group $G$ is a character of $G$ when there are a finite-dimensional complex vector space $V$ and a representation $\rho$ of $G$ on $V$ whose character $g \mapsto \operatorname{tr} \rho(g)$ equals $\varphi$.
nodes.title: Characters of a group

nodes.summary: For a subgroup $H$ of a group $G$, the permutation character $1_H^G : G \to \mathbb{Q}$ sends $g \in G$ to the number of left cosets $xH$ of $H$ with $gxH = xH$, and to $0$ when $g$ fixes infinitely many cosets.
nodes.title: Rational permutation character on the cosets of a subgroup

nodes.summary: For a subgroup $H$ of a group $G$, the permutation character $1_H^G : G \to \mathbb{C}$ sends $g \in G$ to the number of left cosets $xH$ of $H$ with $gxH = xH$, and to $0$ when $g$ fixes infinitely many cosets. For finite $G$ and the trivial subgroup $H = 1$ this is the regular character $1^G$.
nodes.title: Complex permutation character on the cosets of a subgroup

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
